title: Settlement, Servicemember and Disaster Terms Sheet — Hardship Assistance Programs
content:
Three of the Hardship Assistance Programs carry terms of their own: the Charged-Off Settlement Plan, the Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit and the Disaster Relief Deferral. This sheet gives those terms for every program, the other programs showing their "not applicable" or zero values.

## Settlement terms

| Program | Lump-sum settlement percent (%) | Installment settlement percent (%) | Most settlement installments | Form 1099-C threshold on forgiven amount (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term Payment Deferral | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Reduced Payment Plan | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Temporary Rate Reduction Plan | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Term Extension Modification | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Disaster Relief Deferral | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Charged-Off Settlement Plan | 55 | 70 | 6 | 600.00 |

- **Lump-sum settlement percent**: percent of the charged-off balance accepted as a single settlement payment; 0 for other programs.
- **Installment settlement percent**: percent of the charged-off balance accepted when paid in installments; 0 for other programs.
- **Most settlement installments**: most monthly installments a settlement may be spread over; 0 for other programs.
- **Form 1099-C threshold**: forgiven amount at or above which a Form 1099-C is issued, USD; 0 when nothing is forgiven.

## Servicemember and disaster terms

| Program | Fees count toward the rate cap | Loan must be funded before service start | FEMA declaration type required | Request window after the qualifying event (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term Payment Deferral | no | no | not applicable | 0 |
| Reduced Payment Plan | no | no | not applicable | 0 |
| Temporary Rate Reduction Plan | no | no | not applicable | 0 |
| Term Extension Modification | no | no | not applicable | 0 |
| Disaster Relief Deferral | no | no | major disaster with Individual Assistance | 90 |
| Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit | yes | yes | not applicable | 180 |
| Charged-Off Settlement Plan | no | no | not applicable | 0 |

- **Fees count toward the rate cap**: whether fees count toward the program's rate cap (the cap covers interest, fees and charges together).
- **Loan funded before service start**: whether the loan must have been funded before the service start date.
- **FEMA declaration type**: FEMA declaration type that must cover the borrower's county; "not applicable" for other programs.
- **Request window**: calendar days after the qualifying event within which the request must be made: for Disaster Relief the FEMA declaration date, for Servicemember the end of military service; 0 when there is no window.

## Hypothetical reading

A forgiven remainder of 600.00 USD is at the 1099-C threshold and is reported; a forgiven remainder of 599.99 USD is below it.
